functional_barrier.method: Three consecutive fresh stable input/paint samples and all CPUs halted

checks: Readable semantic Clear search and result-only footer preserve actual Ctrl+F, text editing, supported category results and Enter navigate all five real categories without writing preferences or changing appearance
Actual display-size preview and Cancel restore the previous scale, or a too-small physical profile refuses 200% with recovery text; the complete disk is unchanged
No-results/Clear recover browsing; Escape clears search then leaves it before cancelling only the owning appearance preview, with an independently identical complete disk
Two live generations retain independent temporary queries; the actual minimum 700x600 window retains search, categories, matching results and Apply/Restore controls inside its bounds
Light/dark are actually applied and independently read from the saved appearance record; high-contrast search uses the real accessibility flag and remains reachable at the minimum window size
A real saved taskbar-pin notification uses the lower caption-safe rectangle; every live caption remains outside it and actual Dismiss clears the message
Two ordinary no-ISO disk startups reload exact saved appearance and minimum bounds, clear temporary searches, navigate a real result and halt at idle
